buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions 1. The rates to be quoted should be inclusive of cost and all taxes etc. 2. The firm should have valid GSTIN (enclose copy).

3. The firm should have an experience of at least 03 years in photocopying work along with client satisfactory report in at least three Central/state Govt./PSU/Aut onomous Bodies. 4. It shall be obligatory on the part of the contractor to carry out photocopying work under his direct control & supervision and under no circumstances the wor k shall be assigned to sub-contractor. 5. For photocopying work, it shall be obligatory on the part of the contractor to i nstall Three Heavy Duty Photocopier Machines and depute Two technician’s/ ph otocopier operators at client location on all working days throughout the period from 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM. If any eventuality arises, the Department i.e. Central Agency Section (CAS) shall be within its competence to requisition the services of the photocopier operator on Sunday/Holiday and beyond office hours without payment of any additional remuneration. The contractor shall also keep sufficie nt stock of photocopy papers/ spare parts/ toner, which may be required for co mpletion of task, during the currency of the contract 6. The work shall be carried out in the premises of the Department i.e. Central A gency Section (CAS). Only such work execution of which is not possible in the pr emises of the CAS may be allowed to be done in the office of the firm. 7. The contractor shall be responsible for handing over all the photocopies alon g with the original in proper condition with all the papers to the CAS on the expi ry of the contract and the cost of shortcoming, if any, shall be borne by the outg oing contractor. 8. The delay caused, if any, through negligence or otherwise, shall be at risk, co st and responsibility of the contractor. The financial or any other loss suffered b y the government on this account shall be compensated by the contractor and decision of the CAS in this context shall be binding on the contractor. 9. The contract shall cover all the photocopying tasks/ assignments given by Ce ntral Agency Section, Department of Legal Affairs at Supreme Court compound and ILI Building. However, the payment will be made on actual number of photo copies done by the firm (in addition to charges of operators/ technician) and dul y verified by users. 10. No advance payment will be made. The payment in respect of job/ task und ertaken by the firm shall be made by the CAS at the rates approved as early as

possible on the basis of receipt of bills (along with a certificate from the concern ed officer towards satisfactory completion of the work) in this regard. 11. This contract will be valid for a period of two years from the date of award of contract. However, the same can be terminated even before the scheduled dat ed of its expiry in case the firm fails to provide satisfactory services or comply with any of the terms and conditions of the contract failing which security mone y deposited by the firm will also be liable to be forfeited. The decision of the CAS in this regard will be final and binding on the Contractor. 12. The successful bidder shall be required to enter into an agreement with the Department as per the provisions of GFR-2017. 13. The CAS reserves the right to reject any or all the bids without assigning any reason therefore. 14. Taxes will be deducted at source as per rules. 15. If any dispute(s) arises between the CAS and the firm with reference to the c ontract, the CAS will decide it and its decision will be binding on the firms. 16. The successful bidder will be required to deposit a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- (Ru pees Five Lakh only) as performance security money in form of Bank Guarantee / Fixed Deposit in a Commercial Bank in favour of ‘DDO, Central Agency Section’ payable at New Delhi, which will be refundable after satisfactory completion of t he contract. If at any stage the services of the firm are not found suitable/appro priate, the contract shall liable to be terminated and security deposit shall also be likely to be forfeited. 17. It may be specially noted that the bid not meeting even the basic cost of the inputs i.e. unreasonably low prices just to undercut and obtain contract are liabl e to be ignored to maintain the required standards of work being awarded. The unrealistic rates shall not be entertained and reasonability of rates shall be asce rtained according to the item of works. 18. The rates are being obtained for unit items and payment shall be made on t he basis of actual work done. The installation of photocopier machines, providin g all consumable items i.e. A4 paper (75 GSM) and toner, replacement of spare parts, maintenance etc. shall be responsibility of firm/ contractor engaged. The Department shall be providing space for installation of photocopier machines an d power supply.

19. The bidder must quote only one rate for any particular item for which he is c apable of giving as per the specification and the rate column of no item must be left blank or mentioned as free service. 20. The contract shall be valid for two years with effect from the date of its acce ptance and may be extended for another one year, if required by mutual conse nt of the Department and the contractor. The extended contract may be extend ed if the services of agency found satisfactory and if the agency submit a reque st to extend the contract on the same rate, terms & condition. 21. In case the firm/agency want to terminate the contract, it shall have to give three calendar months’ notice of its intention. 22. Notwithstanding any clause in these documents, if the assigned work is not completed to the satisfaction of the CAS, no payment will be made for that work and the decision of the department shall be final in that regard. 23. The CAS reserves the right to withhold payment in the event of non- comme ncement or unsatisfactory performance by the selected bidder. In such eventuality, the CAS further reserves the right to get the work done from open market at the cost of the contractor. Selected bidder will be black listed by the Government for a period of four years to participate in any type of tender & his security money shall also be forfeited. 24. If any information furnished by selected bidder is found to be incorrect or fal se at any time, the contract will be liable to be terminated without any notice an d the security deposit is liable to be forfeited. 25. The photocopying should be attended within 2 hours and failure on the acco unt will tender the firm liable up to a fine of Rs.200/- per day. If the firm fail to at tend to any photocopying within 03 working days, the contract may be cancelle d without any further notice after approval of the competent authority. 26. The contractor shall submit a Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Cert ificate at the time of award of contract. 27. All documents, whether hard or soft copy, are to be treated as strictly conf idential. No document shall be stored on personal devices, cloud platforms or e xternal storage devices. Any breach of confidentiality shall result in forfeiture of

security deposit, removal from the panel and possible legal action under releva nt laws. 28. The following Self attested documents must be upload on GEM portal: i. GST registration; ii. PAN card; iii. Copy of GST & IT return for the last three years; iv. List/Name of Two Technicians/ photocopy operators who will be available aft er contract along-with their Police Verification and ITI Certificate; v. Scanned copy of Affidavit certified by Notary from agency for no police case/ no vigilance case pending/not punished by any court/ non-blacklist certificate o n Rs.100/- stamp paper; vi. A Bid Specific authorization certificate of a reputed brand of Photocopier mac hines must be uploaded along with the documents; vii. Certificate of non-liquidation/ non-court receivership/ non-bankrupt; viii. The bidder should not have been blacklisted by any Central/State Govt./Se mi Govt./PSU/Autonomous body; ix. Similar nature of work order of any three Ministries/Departments/ PSUs- The bidder must have successfully executed/completed similar services over the las t three years i.e. current financial year and the last three financial years (ending month of March prior to the bid opening): - a. Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 4 0% (forty percent) of the estimated cost; or b. Two similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 50 % (fifty percent) of the estimated cost; or c. One similar completed service costing not less than the amount equal to 80% (eighty percent) of the estimated cost. * MSE/Start-up Bidders are to be exempted. A valid MSE Certificate must be pro vided.

x. The office location of the bidder shall be located in Delhi only; certificate relat ed to official address has to be uploaded; xi. Minimum average annual turnover of the bidder during the last three financi al years ending on 31st March, 2026 should be Rs.50 lakh and Bidder Net-worth should be positive in last three financial years ending on 31.03.2026 (Statemen t certified by Chartered Accountant to be uploaded). (valid MSE/Startup Bidders are to be exempted); xii. The firm should be ESI/EPF registered firm 3 years prior to issue of this bid. ( Copy of certificate to be attached); xiii. All the participating firms are required to visit the Central Agency Section (C AS) to understand the nature of services, timelines and quality to be provided. T he firm shall obtain a certificate in this regard from the Admin-CAS Section, 2nd floor, Indian Law Institute, Bhagwan Dass Road, New Delhi which must be uploa ded with the bid documents. The firm failing to visit the CAS shall be summarily rejected while technical evaluation; xiv. Bidders shall submit the EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) @ 2% of the bid valu e. (valid MSE/Start-up Bidders are to be exempted, subject to valid supporting d ocument for the relevant category); and xv. IP Address should be unique. 29. Three heavy duty photocopier machines along with Two photocopy machi ne operators/ technicians with the following specification shall be installed in th e premises of Indian Law Institute in the space provided by the Central Agency Section:- S. No. Description Requirement 1. Type of Machine Digital Laser Mono Multifunction Machine 2. Platen Size A3

3. Paper Size A3/A4 4. Min RAM in MB 6144 5. Min Hard Disk 128 GB SSD Only 6. A4 Copy/Print Speed - Mono 75 7. Network Print/Scan Required 8. Duplexing Print/Scan Required 9. Original Document Feeder DSDF/SPDF 10. Original Document Feeder Cap 300 acity 11. Number of Main Paper Tray 3 12. Bypass Facility Yes 13. Duty Cycle 590000 Copies 14. Paper Capacity (STD/MAX) 3520 Sheets / 8000 Sheets 30. In case of any contradiction between the GEM T&C and the Scope of work an d General/Special T&C uploaded hereby, the latter shall prevail over the GEM T &C. .
